tools.name: tv2_context
tools.description: Current project identity, revision, digest, clock, selection, transport, permissions and real limits. Start here.

tools.name: tv2_query
tools.description: Page project objects in stable storage order; optional text matches names/labels/comments case-insensitively before pagination. Time is source for items, sequence for clips/markers. Preview reads the exact prepared proposal.

tools.name: tv2_evidence
tools.description: Page immutable source evidence. words/utterances/laughter/arousal/emotions return original records filtered by source time, track_id and case-insensitive text in scalar record fields. index lists sections; other sections return bounded metadata summaries.

tools.name: tv2_jobs
tools.description: Page the running application's job records; no model/inference jobs exist.

tools.name: tv2_events
tools.description: Poll bounded session audit events by monotonic cursor. gap=true means earlier entries expired.

tools.name: tv2_audit
tools.description: Page saved project audit metadata by verified archive cursor. Cursor binds the archive digest; restart when audit changes. Omits whole command/project snapshot bodies.

tools.name: tv2_propose
tools.description: Dry-run a closed typed editorial command. Returns diff and exact preview digest; local review is required before apply. Never replaces project state.

tools.name: tv2_reprepare
tools.description: Re-run a restored or obsolete proposal against current revision/digest with a NEW idempotency key. Creates a new exact preview requiring local review or explicit local automatic command scope.

tools.name: tv2_proposals
tools.description: Page dry-run proposals, diffs, local review status and apply receipts for this control session.

tools.name: tv2_preview
tools.description: Page project objects in stable storage order; optional text matches names/labels/comments case-insensitively before pagination. Time is source for items, sequence for clips/markers. Preview reads the exact prepared proposal.

tools.name: tv2_apply
tools.description: Commit a prepared command authorized by exact local review or current local automatic command scope, rejecting obsolete revision/content. Repeat the same proposal/key to retrieve its receipt; verify afterward.

tools.name: tv2_verify
tools.description: Verify current content in a background hash worker. verification=pending has null matches_preview/digests; retry after retry_after_ms until complete. Always reports the live session receipt and save status; any snapshot change invalidates cached verification.

tools.name: tv2_select
tools.description: Set live GUI selection after validating IDs and revision. Empty selection clears it.

tools.name: tv2_transport
tools.description: Control the running GUI player. seek requires position_ticks in sequence flicks.
